records.evidence_source_family: JRA current all-news index plus explicit meeting-cancellation articles
records.notes: Production scans the official current all-news index, fetches bounded cancellation/change candidate articles, accepts only explicit whole-meeting cancellation wording, binds venue/date to an existing canonical meeting, rejects race-only cancellation wording, and fails closed on news-index/article fetch failure. The deprecated /news/YYYYMM/ assumption is not used.

records.evidence_source_family: NAR official JRA-net topic notices — explicit positive-evidence subset, non-exhaustive
records.notes: Production scans bounded official NAR JRA-net topic year indexes for explicit whole-meeting cancellation notices covering the 14 flat NAR racecourses. Only venue-bound whole-meeting title/body evidence is accepted; race-only notices and Banei are rejected. This route is an auxiliary positive-evidence subset and is not treated as an exhaustive nationwide cancellation feed: no matching notice or any source failure remains absent_unconfirmed and preserves verified state. Replacement/rescheduled dates are independent meetings.

records.evidence_source_family: Banei Tokachi monthly TOPICS archive plus explicit cancellation articles
records.notes: Production scans bounded official monthly TOPICS archive pages for cancellation-related candidate articles, accepts only whole-day/multi-day Banei cancellation evidence, rejects partial-race stoppages and external-racing notices, binds evidence to existing canonical meetings, and fails closed on archive/article fetch failure.

records.evidence_source_family: HKJC official fixture page final-announcement cancellation text
records.notes: The already-collected official monthly fixture page is parsed only for an explicit whole-meeting sentence ('The race meeting originally scheduled ... will be/has been/is cancelled'). Race-only cancellation wording is rejected. Confirmed records are emitted into the rolling artifact and durably persisted before public suppression.

The already-collected official racecard/declarations route is parsed only for the exact whole-meeting status 'THIS MEETING HAS BEEN CANCELLED'. Race-only wording is rejected. Confirmed records are emitted into the rolling artifact and durably persisted before public suppression.

records.evidence_source_family: KRA official operation-plan and race-fast-report sources; no stable whole-meeting cancellation route proven
records.notes: KRA exposes race-level changes and official operating plans, but this audit did not prove a stable machine-readable whole-meeting cancellation/postponement route. Retain verified meetings on absence.

records.evidence_source_family: TJK official news articles with explicit domestic whole-meeting postponement/cancellation wording
records.notes: Official TJK news proves domestic whole-meeting postponement/cancellation and a bounded parser now requires a known domestic venue plus explicit all-races (`tüm koşular`) body evidence. Race-only and foreign-racing notices are rejected, and replacement dates remain independent meetings. Automated discovery is deliberately not active: both filtered and unfiltered Haberler requests timed out from GitHub Actions during PR #1110 live-route probes, so production keeps the safe reviewed path and never treats programme/news absence as cancellation.

records.evidence_source_family: SOREC Galop official status-bearing calendar GET; bounded embedded joursEvenement REPOR positive-evidence subset
records.notes: Production reads only the official menu-derived calendar GET's embedded joursEvenement status data. The previously tested opaque fctID route returned HTTP 404 in production refresh run 35694598167; PR #1126 / Actions run 35695280068 proved the stable full menu route code=CALEN, description=Calendrier courses, fctID=1406 with HTTP 200 and all required structural fingerprints. A date is eligible only when it has exactly one status row and that row is REPOR, the REPOR message supplies a strictly later replacement date, the original calendar-key date is inside the requested window, and exactly one existing SOREC canonical meeting can be bound on that original date. Dates with RESDE or any other sibling status, duplicate REPOR rows, missing/same/backward replacement dates, or zero/multiple canonical bindings are skipped. The replacement date is never generated or bound from this negative-evidence route. Calendar fetch/parse failure emits no negative evidence and preserves verified state; Programme Réunion absence remains absent_unconfirmed.

records.evidence_source_family: Club Hípico de Santiago official Corporativo news archive — bounded Santiago-only explicit whole-meeting positive-evidence subset
records.notes: Production uses the official Club Hípico de Santiago Corporativo archive only as a bounded positive-evidence subset inside the broader Chile/Teletrak system. Candidate articles are fetched from official clubhipico.cl news URLs. Only explicit whole-meeting suspension/postponement/recalendarization wording with an original meeting date may bind, and only to exactly one existing canonical Club Hípico de Santiago meeting on that date. Notices limited to races from a stated ordinal onward or to the first/last races are rejected and never suppress the whole meeting. Other Chile venues remain uncovered by this negative-evidence route. Archive/article absence or fetch/parse failure emits no negative evidence and preserves verified state. Replacement dates, when stated, are evidence only and are never generated as meetings.

records.evidence_source_family: HRI annual fixture PDF and racecard Meeting Updates; stable whole-meeting status route not yet proven
records.notes: HRI clearly handles abandoned/rescheduled fixtures operationally, but the current WHR source routes do not yet prove a bounded whole-meeting non-running parser. Retain on absence until that route is demonstrated.

records.evidence_source_family: Monterrico official programme/date API plus Jockey Club del Perú racing regulations; regulations distinguish race annulment from force-majeure whole-meeting suspension, but no live final-status publication route is proven
records.notes: Official regulations expressly allow a race to be annulled and, separately, allow a meeting already underway to be suspended for force majeure. This proves the semantic distinction but not a machine-readable live cancellation route. Programme/date API absence or failure remains absent_unconfirmed and preserves verified state.

records.evidence_source_family: JCSA official venue-season and date race routes; no bounded whole-meeting negative-evidence route proven in this country-addition pass
records.notes: Saudi Calendar production uses JCSA positive schedule sources. A missing date-route meeting fingerprint remains absent_unconfirmed. Whole-meeting cancellation/postponement automation is intentionally not implemented by this expansion lane.
